name: Create Compliance Job
description: Create Compliance Job Creates a new Compliance Job for the specified job type. POST /2/compliance/jobs
context:
POST /2/compliance/jobs
Creates a new Compliance Job for the specified job type.
Required: body (body)
Optional: compliance_job.fields (query) — A comma separated list of ComplianceJob fields to display.

name: Cancel Compliance Job
description: Cancel Compliance Job Cancels a Compliance Job that has not finished processing; its status becomes failed and a new job of the same type can be created. DELETE /2/compliance/jobs/{id}
context:
DELETE /2/compliance/jobs/{id}
Cancels a Compliance Job that has not finished processing; its status becomes failed and a new job of the same type can be created.
Required: id (path)
Optional: compliance_job.fields (query) — A comma separated list of ComplianceJob fields to display.

name: Download Compliance Job Results
description: Download Compliance Job Results Downloads the results file of a completed Compliance Job using the signed URL returned at job creation. GET /2/compliance/jobs/{id}/download
context:
GET /2/compliance/jobs/{id}/download
Downloads the results file of a completed Compliance Job using the signed URL returned at job creation.
Required: id (path); token (query) — Signed download token from the job's download_url.
Optional: compliance_job.fields (query) — A comma separated list of ComplianceJob fields to display.

name: Get Compliance Jobs
description: Get Compliance Jobs Retrieves a list of Compliance Jobs filtered by job type and optional status. GET /2/compliance/jobs
context:
GET /2/compliance/jobs
Retrieves a list of Compliance Jobs filtered by job type and optional status.
Required: type (query)
Optional: status (query); compliance_job.fields (query) — A comma separated list of ComplianceJob fields to display.

name: Get Compliance Job by ID
description: Get Compliance Job by ID Retrieves details of a specific Compliance Job by its ID. GET /2/compliance/jobs/{id}
context:
GET /2/compliance/jobs/{id}
Retrieves details of a specific Compliance Job by its ID.
Required: id (path)
Optional: compliance_job.fields (query) — A comma separated list of ComplianceJob fields to display.

name: Upload Compliance Job Submission
description: Upload Compliance Job Submission Uploads the newline-delimited ID file for a Compliance Job using the signed URL returned at job creation. PUT /2/compliance/jobs/{id}/upload
context:
PUT /2/compliance/jobs/{id}/upload
Uploads the newline-delimited ID file for a Compliance Job using the signed URL returned at job creation.
Required: id (path); token (query) — Signed upload token from the job's upload_url.; body (body)
Optional: compliance_job.fields (query) — A comma separated list of ComplianceJob fields to display.
